# Set Up

This page provides a sample Site KRI Report generated using the standard KRIs included in the `gsm.kri` package. Expand the "Setup" section below to see the code used to generate the report. Or scroll down for the standard KRI report output.

The example combines the `gsm.core` KRI results with synthetic monitoring
decisions to demonstrate the 90-day Review Priority Score. These decision dates
are demonstration data, not inferred dates from the ActionLog fixture. The
actions refer only to actual flagged snapshots for currently flagged, active
site/KRI pairs. Open actions, closed actions, and signals awaiting triage vary
across sites. A closed action does not change the underlying KRI flag. Dates
remain inside the bundled reporting history rather than inventing older evidence.

<details>
<summary>Setup</summary>

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(gsm.core)
library(gsm.kri)
library(here)

dfMetrics <- gsm.core::reportingMetrics %>%
  dplyr::filter(MetricID == "Analysis_kri0001") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    MetricID = "Analysis_kri9999",
    Metric = "Retired Metric",
    Abbreviation = "RET",
    Active = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(gsm.core::reportingMetrics, .)
dfResults <- gsm.core::reportingResults %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    MetricID == "Analysis_kri0001",
    SnapshotDate < max(SnapshotDate)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(MetricID = "Analysis_kri9999") %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(gsm.core::reportingResults, .)

latest_snapshot <- max(gsm.core::reportingResults$SnapshotDate)
weights <- gsm.kri::MakeWeights(gsm.core::reportingMetrics)
active_site_metrics <- gsm.core::reportingMetrics %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$GroupLevel == "Site", .data$Active %in% TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::pull("MetricID")
current_kri_results <- gsm.core::reportingResults %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$SnapshotDate == latest_snapshot,
    .data$GroupLevel == "Site",
    grepl("^Analysis_kri", .data$MetricID),
    .data$MetricID %in% active_site_metrics
  )
current_flagged <- current_kri_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$Flag), .data$Flag != 0) %>%
  dplyr::select("StudyID", "GroupLevel", "GroupID", "MetricID", "Flag")
demo_action_log <- gsm.core::reportingResults %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(
    current_flagged,
    by = c("StudyID", "GroupLevel", "GroupID", "MetricID", "Flag")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$SnapshotDate <= latest_snapshot) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$StudyID, .data$GroupLevel, .data$GroupID, .data$MetricID) %>%
  dplyr::slice_min(.data$SnapshotDate, n = 1L, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$MetricID, .data$GroupID) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$MetricID) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(decision_group = (dplyr::row_number() - 1L) %% 5L) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ExtractionDate = latest_snapshot,
    RiskSignalID = paste0("DEMO-RS-", seq_len(dplyr::n())),
    State = c("Open Action", "Closed Action", "Awaiting Triage", "Open Action", "Closed Action")[.data$decision_group + 1L],
    ActionID = dplyr::if_else(.data$State == "Awaiting Triage", NA_character_, paste0("DEMO-ACT-", seq_len(dplyr::n()))),
    ActionedDate = latest_snapshot - pmin(
      c(14, 35, NA_real_, 45, 59)[.data$decision_group + 1L],
      as.integer(latest_snapshot - .data$SnapshotDate)
    ),
    ActionedDateSource = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(.data$ActionedDate), "Synthetic flag-matched monitoring decision", NA_character_),
    ActionedFlag = dplyr::if_else(.data$State == "Awaiting Triage", NA_real_, as.numeric(.data$Flag)),
    ActionScope = dplyr::if_else(.data$State == "Awaiting Triage", NA_character_, "SiteMetric"),
    ActionCriticality = dplyr::if_else(.data$State == "Awaiting Triage", NA, FALSE),
    ActionState = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(.data$ActionID), .data$State, NA_character_),
    ActionCreatedDate = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$State == "Closed Action", pmax(.data$SnapshotDate, .data$ActionedDate - 7), .data$ActionedDate
    ),
    ActionResolvedDate = dplyr::if_else(.data$State == "Closed Action", .data$ActionedDate, as.Date(NA))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-"decision_group")
weighted_kri_results <- current_kri_results %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(weights, by = c("MetricID", "Flag"))
action_weighted_score <- gsm.kri::CalculateActionRiskScore(
  dfResults = weighted_kri_results,
  dfWeights = weights,
  dfActionLog = demo_action_log,
  intActionWindowDays = 90,
  bActionHistoryComplete = TRUE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    StudyID = unique(current_kri_results$StudyID),
    SnapshotDate = latest_snapshot
  )

# Per-KRI detail explains the priority score without changing the original SRS.
action_score_detail <- gsm.kri::MakeActionRiskScoreDetail(
  dfResults = weighted_kri_results,
  dfWeights = weights,
  dfActionLog = demo_action_log,
  intActionWindowDays = 90,
  bActionHistoryComplete = TRUE
)
unweighted_kri_results <- current_kri_results %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(
    weighted_kri_results,
    by = c("StudyID", "SnapshotDate", "GroupLevel", "GroupID", "MetricID")
  )
if (nrow(unweighted_kri_results) > 0L) {
  unweighted_detail <- gsm.kri::MakeActionSummary(
    dfResults = unweighted_kri_results,
    dfActionLog = demo_action_log,
    intActionWindowDays = 90,
    bActionHistoryComplete = TRUE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Weight = NA_real_, WeightMax = NA_real_, EffectiveWeight = NA_real_)
  action_score_detail <- dplyr::bind_rows(action_score_detail, unweighted_detail)
}
demo_signal_states <- demo_action_log %>%
  dplyr::select("StudyID", "GroupLevel", "GroupID", "MetricID", DemoSignalState = "State")
action_score_detail <- action_score_detail %>%
  dplyr::left_join(demo_signal_states, by = c("StudyID", "GroupLevel", "GroupID", "MetricID")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ActionState = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$ActionState, .data$DemoSignalState,
      dplyr::if_else(is.na(.data$Flag), "Not assessed", "Not flagged")
    ),
    ActionReason = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$ActionState == "Awaiting Triage" ~ "Awaiting triage",
      is.na(.data$Flag) ~ "Not assessed",
      .data$Flag == 0 ~ "Not flagged",
      TRUE ~ .data$ActionReason
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-"DemoSignalState")

site_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dfResults,
  action_weighted_score
)

## Site Report
lCharts <- gsm.kri::MakeCharts(
  dfResults = site_results,
  dfGroups = gsm.core::reportingGroups,
  dfMetrics = dfMetrics,
  dfBounds = gsm.core::reportingBounds
)
```

</details>

# Report

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
## Render example report inline using knit_child
child_env <- list2env(
  list(
    params = list(
      lCharts = lCharts,
  dfResults = site_results,
      dfGroups = gsm.core::reportingGroups,
  dfMetrics = dfMetrics,
      strComparisonRiskMetric = "Analysis_srs0002",
      strComparisonRiskLabel = "Review Priority Score",
      dfRiskScoreDetail = action_score_detail
    )
  ),
  parent = environment()
)
report_kri <- knitr::knit_child(
  system.file("report", "Report_KRI.Rmd", package = "gsm.kri"),
  envir = child_env,
  quiet = TRUE
)
cat(report_kri, sep = "\n")
```
